configs.colour_accuracy: lc (leading colour): one program per (process, colour flow)

types.p<l>: [f64; 4]: the momentum of external leg l, [E, px, py, pz]
types.q<i>: [f64; 4]: a momentum form, [E, px, py, pz]
types.crossing: Option<Vec<{leg: usize, sign: f64}>>: per leg of the program, the caller's leg it reads and its sign
types.c<i>: [Complex<f64>; N], N = components: 1 scalar, 2 Weyl spinor, 4 vector or Dirac spinor, 6 antisymmetric tensor
types.s<i>: Complex<f64>: a scale (a coupling or a mass; a mass and a kernel input use its real part, f64)
types.currents[i].source: Option<{wavefunction: String, family: "scalar" | "weyl" | "dirac" | "vector", orientation: "particle" | "antiparticle", leg: Option<usize>, momentum: q<i>, helicity: i32 (-1, 0, +1), chirality: i32 (-1, 0, +1), mass: s<i>, factor: x<i>}>: present exactly when initial is "source"
types.bindings[i].inputs: [f64; n]: the kernel's inputs, each a real number (the re or im part of a complex operand)
types.bindings[i].outputs: [usize; m]: the components of out that the kernel's m output pairs (Complex<f64>) go to
types.outputs[h]: f64: the value of helicity configuration h, |M_h|² with its weights
types.output.helicities[h].legs: [i32; legs]: the helicity of each leg
types.inputs.alpha_s: Option<{name: String, value: f64, power: i32}>
types.examples: momenta: [[f64; 4]; legs]: the caller's momenta of one point

conventions.points: every program is evaluated per phase-space point; all values below are per point
conventions.names: c<i>: a current (currents[i]); c<i>[j]: its component j (c<i> alone: component 0 or, as an operand, the whole current); a<i>: an amplitude (amplitudes[i]); q<i>: a momentum form (inputs.forms[i]); s<i>: a scale (inputs.scales[i]); x<i>: an exact factor (inputs.factors[i]); b<i>: a symjit binding (bindings[i]); k<i>: a symjit kernel (kernels[i]); p<l>: the momentum of external leg l
conventions.momenta: p<l> = sign × (the caller's momentum of leg inputs.crossing[l].leg), [E, px, py, pz]; with no crossing p<l> is the caller's leg l
conventions.forms: q<i> = Σ coefficient × p<leg> over its terms, per component (the first term added to 0.0, in term order)
conventions.minkowski: a·b = a0 b0 - a1 b1 - a2 b2 - a3 b3
conventions.mode: "=": the instruction's value is stored into its output; "+=": added to it (in body order: the sums are not reordered)
conventions.initial: a current's value before the body: "zero" (all components 0), "source" (the external wavefunction its `source` field describes), "written" (none: the body's first instruction writing it has mode "="), "arena" (read before any instruction writes it: whatever its planes hold)

sources.notation: a source current's value is factor × w, w the wavefunction of its `wavefunction` field (RustiCol's wavefunctions.rs, in f64): k = (E, px, py, pz) its momentum form, h its helicity, ch its chirality, m the real part of its mass scale; p_T = √(px² + py²); |k| = √(px² + py² + pz²); sign(x) = ±1 with the sign of x (+1 for +0); an incoming leg has E < 0 (its form is minus its momentum)
sources.weyl particle: E > 0: s = 0 if px = py = 0 and pz < 0, else √max(E + pz, 0); a = s; b = −h√(2E) if s = 0, else h·px/s − i·py/s; (h, ch) = (+1, +1): w = (a, b); (−1, −1): w = (b, a); else w = (0, 0). E ≤ 0: s = 0 if px = py = 0 and pz > 0, else −√max(−(E + pz), 0); a = s; b = −h√(2|E|) if s = 0, else h·px/s + i·py/s; (h, ch) = (−1, +1): w = (a, b); (+1, −1): w = (b, a); else w = (0, 0)
sources.weyl antiparticle: E > 0: s = 0 if px = py = 0 and pz < 0, else −√max(E + pz, 0); a = s; b = −h√(2E) if s = 0, else −h·px/s + i·py/s; (h, ch) = (+1, +1): w = (b, a); (−1, −1): w = (a, b); else w = (0, 0). E ≤ 0: s = 0 if px = py = 0 and pz > 0, else √max(−(E + pz), 0); a = s; b = −h√(2|E|) if s = 0, else −h·px/s − i·py/s; (h, ch) = (−1, +1): w = (b, a); (+1, −1): w = (a, b); else w = (0, 0)
sources.dirac particle: |m| < 1e-8: a, b as for a weyl particle of the same E branch; E > 0: h = +1: w = (a, b, 0, 0), else (0, 0, b, a); E ≤ 0: h = −1: w = (a, b, 0, 0), else (0, 0, b, a). Massive: n = sign(E), nh = n·h; ω = (√(|E| + |k|), m / √(|E| + |k|)); f1 = (1 + n + (1 − n)·nh)/2, f2 = (1 + n − (1 − n)·nh)/2; ip = (1 + nh)/2, im = (1 − nh)/2 (indices 0, 1); g = (f1·ω[ip], f2·ω[im]); t = n·(px, py, pz); r = max(|k| + t_z, 0); χ = (1 if |k| = 0, else √(r / (2|k|)); −nh if r = 0 or |k| = 0, else (nh·t_x − i·t_y) / √(2|k| r)); w = (χ[im]·g[1], χ[ip]·g[1], χ[im]·g[0], χ[ip]·g[0])
sources.dirac antiparticle: |m| < 1e-8: a, b as for a weyl antiparticle of the same E branch; E > 0: h = −1: w = (0, 0, a, b), else (b, a, 0, 0); E ≤ 0: h = +1: w = (0, 0, a, b), else (b, a, 0, 0). Massive: as a dirac particle with n = −sign(E), χ[1] = nh·t_x + i·t_y over the same denominator, and w = (χ[im]·g[0], χ[ip]·g[0], χ[im]·g[1], χ[ip]·g[1])
sources.vector (massless): m = 0 (gluon, photon). E > 0: w = (0, (−h·px·pz/(E·p_T) − i·py/p_T)/√2, (−h·py·pz/(E·p_T) + i·px/p_T)/√2, h·p_T/(E·√2)); for p_T = 0: w = (0, −h/√2, i·sign(pz)/√2, 0). E ≤ 0: with g = −h and P = −E: w = (0, (−g·px·pz/(P·p_T) + i·py/p_T)/√2, (−g·py·pz/(P·p_T) − i·px/p_T)/√2, g·p_T/(P·√2)); for p_T = 0: w = (0, −g/√2, −i·sign(pz)/√2, 0)
sources.vector (massive): m ≠ 0 (Z, W). If E < 0: k → −k, h → −h first. P = min(E, |k|), q = min(P, p_T), l = 1 − |h| (1 for the longitudinal state), n = |h|; P = 0: w = (0, −h/√2, i·n/√2, l); else, with e = E/(m·P) and z = pz·h/(P·q·√2): w = (l·P/m, l·px·e − px·z − i·n·py/(q·√2), l·py·e − py·z + i·n·px/(q·√2), l·pz·e + h·q/(P·√2)); for q = 0 the middle two are −h/√2 and i·n·sign(pz)/√2

conventions.output: outputs[h] = group_factor × Σ weight × |a|² over reduction[h]'s terms, in order (|a|² = fma(re, re, im × im)); the outputs are the helicity configurations of output.helicities; the matrix element is Σ_h outputs[h]
conventions.alpha_s: the program's scales and factors are those at inputs.alpha_s.value; outputs scale as (alpha_s / value)^power

instructions.notation: an instruction's operands are its fields: in[0], in[1] (input currents), out (output current), current (a current changed in place), momenta[0], momenta[1] and momentum (forms), amplitude; x[j] is component j of operand x (complex for currents, real for momenta: [E, px, py, pz]); j counts components from 0. In the formulas below l = in[0], r = in[1], o = the value computed, c = current, k = momentum, u = momenta[0], v = momenta[1]; i is the imaginary unit

vertex.meaning: out[j] (mode)= o[j] × coupling × factor for each component j of the type's output
vertex.three_vector: l vector (4), r vector (4) → vector (4), the colour-ordered three-gluon vertex: o[j] = (l·r)(u[j] - v[j]) + 2((l·v) r[j] - (r·u) l[j])
vertex.momenta: read by three_vector only; for the other types they are the momenta the inputs carry

propagator.meaning: current[j] = o[j] × factor / (k·k) for each component j
propagator.vector: c vector (4), Feynman gauge: o[j] = -i c[j]

instructions.closure: amplitude += Σ_j in[0][j] × in[1][j] × component_factors[j] × factor, j < components
instructions.source: current = factor × the external wavefunction (RustiCol's wavefunctions.rs) of the leg's momentum
instructions.kernel: the symjit kernel of the binding on the binding's inputs (in f64); its output pair n (re, im) × factor (mode)= out[binding.outputs[n]]; with binding.direct and factor exactly 1 the pair is stored as it is
instructions.binding inputs: re|im in[0][j], re|im in[1][j], re|im out[j]: a part of a component of the kernel row's operands; momenta[0][j], momenta[1][j]: a component of its momenta; s<i>: the real part of scale s<i>; re|im factor: of its factor

kernels.name: k0

library.call: int k0(double *mem, const symjit_slice *states, size_t idx, const double *params), symjit_slice = {double *ptr; size_t len}: states = the input planes (the binding's inputs, in order) then the output planes (re, im of each output pair); k0(NULL, states, i, params) reads point i of each input plane and writes point i of each output plane; 0 on success. See the header

kernels.format: a symjit plane application (.plane.symjit: the MIR of one executor row, f64); inputs and outputs as the bindings list them, each output a (re, im) pair
